item.title: Lion vs Crocodile: The Savannah Water's Edge Gamble
item.description:
Lion vs Crocodile - Every drink at Africa's Savannah waterholes is a calculated risk. A lion pride knows the water's edge better than any other hunting ground — but it's also the one place where the crocodile holds every advantage. When a thirsty pride meets a submerged ambush predator that's been waiting for hours, size and speed on land mean nothing. This is the real standoff scientists have documented at the boundary between two completely different hunting worlds — and the outcome isn't decided by who's bigger.
